regulatory_descriptor: A Non-linked Participating Individual Life Insurance Savings Plan
key_benefits: Guaranteed Maturity Benefit (GMB) chosen at inception, plus Guaranteed Loyalty Additions (GLA) plus Vested Bonus / Interim Bonus / Terminal Bonus, if any, at maturity
Accrued Guaranteed Loyalty Additions of up to 315% of GMB, depending on premium payment term, attached from end of 10th policy year
Death Benefit = Sum Assured on Death plus GLA plus bonuses (if any), subject to Guaranteed Death Benefit of 105% of Total Premiums Paid; Sum Assured = 10x Annualised Premium
Choice of 4 policy terms (15/20/25/30 years) with regular or limited premium payment
Policy loan up to 90% of surrender value
Premium Rebate where chosen GMB exceeds Rs 5,00,000
riders_available: Bajaj Life Accidental Death Benefit Rider (UIN 116B034V02)
Bajaj Life Accidental Permanent Total/Partial Disability Benefit Rider (UIN 116B036V02)

eligibility.note: Numeric eligibility table (entry/maturity ages, min sum-assured, PPT options) not recovered from this brochure parse; maximum Sum Assured per prevailing Board approved underwriting guidelines. Verify against policy document before asserting numeric limits.

key_terms.free_look_note: 30 days from receipt of the Policy Document; refund of premiums (excluding applicable taxes) less proportionate risk premium and medical/stamp-duty expenses; processed within 7 days.
key_terms.suicide_clause: On death by suicide within 12 months from commencement of risk or latest revival (whichever is later), nominee receives higher of 80% of Total Premiums Paid or the surrender benefit as on date of death, provided the policy is in force; policy then terminates.
key_terms.maturity_benefit_condition: Maturity Benefit = GMB + GLA + Vested Bonus (if any) + Interim Bonus (if any) + Terminal Bonus (if any). Only GMB and GLA are guaranteed; bonuses are non-guaranteed.
key_terms.loan_note: Loan up to 90% of surrender value; current interest 10% p.a. compounded half-yearly, benchmarked to 10-year G-Sec + 2%.
key_terms.tax_note: Premium, Maturity, Death and Surrender benefits 'may be eligible' for tax benefits per extant Income Tax Act; consult a tax consultant. GST per prevailing tax laws.

mandatory_disclosures_present: Disclaimer that bonuses projected are not guaranteed and past performance is no indication of future bonuses

claims_marketing_must_support: Only the Guaranteed Maturity Benefit (GMB) and Guaranteed Loyalty Additions (GLA) are guaranteed; any Vested/Interim/Terminal Bonus is non-guaranteed and must be qualified as 'if any' / 'not guaranteed'.
Any 'up to 315% of GMB' Guaranteed Loyalty Additions claim is condition-bound — it depends on the premium payment term chosen and accrues only from the end of the 10th policy year; must be qualified.
Death benefit floor is 105% of Total Premiums Paid; Sum Assured equals 10x Annualised Premium — any cover figure must be consistent with this.
Premium Rebate applies only where chosen GMB exceeds Rs 5,00,000.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT present illustrative 4%/8% returns or any bonus figure as guaranteed or expected — they are illustrative only and do not indicate upper/lower limits of returns.
Do NOT imply Terminal Bonus is always payable — it is payable only if the policy completes 10 years and all due premiums are paid, and is non-guaranteed.
Do NOT overstate the guaranteed portion: 'guaranteed' language is bounded to GMB and GLA only.
Tax benefits must not be stated as assured — always carry the 'subject to prevailing tax laws' caveat.
must_state: Full regulatory descriptor: 'A Non-linked Participating Individual Life Insurance Savings Plan'
That bonuses are not guaranteed and past performance does not indicate future bonuses
Standard disclaimer to read the policy document / benefit illustration for full terms and exclusions
